test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Eight boys Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash, Vivek, Rahul and Ramu are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Vivek is second to the right of Anil. Anil is fourth to the right of Ramu. Sanjay is third to the right of Ram. Ram is not the immediate neighbour of Vivek or Kamal. Ramu is not the immediate neighbour of Rahul.

Who is the immediate neighbour of Anil and Ram?
solution:
Given: Eight boys Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash, Vivek, Rahul and Ramu. 

1) Vivek is second to the right of Anil. 

2) Anil is fourth to the right of Ramu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a3a66245b8d5f48c3c11dbdf0d4ade8d6ac27f03f535f119854d0ec7fe6033e.png] 

3) Ram is not the immediate neighbour of Vivek or Kamal.

4) Sanjay is third to the right of Ram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1c0ea9dfff10892658f29b0520551e777f0d14e748a6c90e310103c67c2fd81.png] 

5) Ramu is not the immediate neighbour of Rahul.

And, Aakash will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bcbb3d7adbb16615bc79a1119d4643c8914e48bec65cbaa1fb77dcff3e729a5.png] 

Here, 'Rahul' is the immediate neighbour of Anil and Ram.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Rahul"**.
